topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I didn't mean for it to happen. It started as a small line, a curve that seemed to fit so well with the skin of the day. The more I drew, the more it felt right, like adding shadows to a bright scene. Now, seeing the artist's face, I realize the weight of it. I only wanted to honor the work, to show how much it meant. The marks are deep, I know, but my intent was pure. I wish I could take it back, erase the lines and start anew. Perhaps, in time, the artist will see the beauty I saw, the way it all seemed to come together.
